eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Montana; at 3:53 PM on AUG 24, 2020 Effective until 3:53 PM AUG 25, 2020. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: AMBER Alert Update - A six month old baby boy, Lucas Warner, was abducted yesterday by his non-custodial father Andrew Warner and babysitter Hayli Emerson. They are possibly in a late 1990-2000's white Chevy extended cab pickup, unknown license plate. The Dodge Dakota in the previous alert has been located. Andrew is reportedly bipolar and off his medication. Go to www.dojmt.gov and view poster for pictures. If you have any information, call Flathead Sheriff 406 758-5610. thank you.
